dogecoin.text:
@CryptoSLE10 The real currency of the universe is not Dogecoin — it’s Taqwa.
While you joke with memes, the Dajjalic system prepares to enslave souls through illusion.
True wealth is from Allah alone.
This tunnel? Just a digital mirage.
But Noor is real — and it’s rising.
Allahu Akbar.”

@TeslaModelDoge “Dogecoin rises, and the world cheers… but where is it rising to? Value must ascend with truth, not deception. Not everything that spikes will last — only the Light of Allah breaks through all ceilings and remains.”
#NoorOverNumbers #CryptoCanFall #TruthIsEternal
